speaker: hired_men
text: Mahomet. On the post by the Bull. I have seen it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Give it me in a breath, Ralph.

speaker: hired_men
text: Rant, in the old Tamburlaine vein. Fireworks. And a head that speaks.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then London will tire of the noise before it tires of a face. I am going up.

speaker: hired_men
text: Titus is at the Keys at two. I am for that. I am not hired at the Rose.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor am I in it. Go. I have the desk, and a bill I have already read.
